meta.title: Remove type parameters quick fix forgets the trailing >
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#40265 (fix(40257): fix type parameters range), 3f92a6498f, 2020-11-02; git tag --contains: first in v4.2-beta / v4.2.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.1.6 (the last 4.1 release; the fix is not on the 4.1 branch) and typescript@4.2.2 (2021-02-25), both behind typescript-language-server@0.5.1 (the latest wrapper release before 4.2.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js (--tsserver-path); the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The wrapper is installed with the npm dependencies of its release date (install_builds.wrapper_before); it logs no TypeScript version, so the build check verifies that the wrapper's tsserver child runs the pinned tsserver.js.
meta.notes: The unused type parameters are reported as a suggestion diagnostic (TS6205 'All type parameters are unused') without any compiler option; the undefined CommandClass/CCResponseRole of the issue's snippet only add unrelated errors. Invalid after two attempts, both case-spec errors that never applied the fix: attempt 1 put the cursor one column past the end of line 1; attempt 2 required the code-action kind 'quickfix', but wrapper 0.5.1 returns quick fixes as bare commands without a kind, so 'Remove type parameters' was offered and filtered out. The log of attempt 2 shows the pre-fix edit deleting line 1 character 31 to line 4 character 0, i.e. the reported '>'-leaving result; not counted.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.note: tab indentation as in the issue

repro.steps: Open index.ts. With the cursor after 'CCResponsePredicate<', inside the span of the 'All type parameters are unused' suggestion (TS6205), trigger the quick fix that removes all type parameters. Reported: the result is 'export type CCResponsePredicate> = ...' (the trailing '>' stays); expected: 'export type CCResponsePredicate = ...'. Probe: the fixed text must not have a parse error the original did not have.

attempts.summary: Code actions requested at line 1, character 33, one past the end of 'export type CCResponsePredicate<' (a column error in the case): the server answered with the fixes for TSent only ('Remove unused declaration for TSent', 'Prefix TSent with an underscore'), so the remove-all-type-parameters fix was not offered on either build (invalid). The session reports 'All type parameters are unused' (TS6205) over the whole list.
